## Original assets (made for this project)

- sanctuary_kit.glb: First Sanctuary architecture kit (columns, arch, lintel, fallen drums), generated procedurally with headless Blender (`scripts/blender/build_sanctuary_kit.py`, optimized by `scripts/build-kit.mjs`). Own work, no third-party content. Blender (GPL) is only the tool; its output is not covered by the GPL.
